levels.full:
# Numbers and colours

## What you will learn
Numbers name quantities; colour adjectives describe objects. In English, a colour usually comes before a noun.

## Example in context
I have three blue pencils. Three is the number; blue is the colour.

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
Do not add plural -s to the adjective: blue pencils, not blues pencils.

## Practice and reflection
Translate: «У меня две красные книги».
**Model answer:** I have two red books.

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.
